Synopsis:
    South Korea's YTD exports have already surpassed the full-year 2025 record at $709.4bn, driven overwhelmingly by semiconductors (+169.6% YoY, 41% of total exports) on the back of AI-driven chip demand. The country is on track to become the fourth nation to reach $1 trillion in annual exports by early December. Export destinations China (+76%) and the US (+57%) are the primary growth drivers. Passenger cars, the second-largest export category, declined 4% over the same period. The article acknowledges headwinds from protectionism and supply chain restructuring but frames the overall tone as strongly positive.
